definitions.explanation: A tiny opening in the skin from which hair grows and through which sweat and oil are secreted. Composed of 毛 (hair) + 穴 (hole). Frequently discussed in skincare and beauty contexts.

examples.japanese: {毛穴|けあな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
{毛穴|けあな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧クレンジング⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a cleanser that removes dirt from pores.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蒸|む}し→蒸す：02307_musu⟧⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{毛穴|けあな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}いて→開く：01979_hiraku⟧、⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れ→取れる：02376_toreru⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Applying a hot towel opens the pores and makes it easier to remove dirt.

notes:
USAGE:
{毛穴|けあな} is very common in skincare and beauty product advertising. Japanese skincare culture places great emphasis on pore care, so this word appears frequently in drugstore product labels, beauty magazines, and cosmetics marketing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毛穴|けあな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (pores open)
- {毛穴|けあな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{締|し}める→引き締める：15264_hikishimeru⟧ (to tighten pores)
- {毛穴|けあな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ (pores are visible/noticeable)
- {毛穴|けあな}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧ (pore care)
- {毛穴|けあな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黒|くろ}ずみ (blackheads — dark buildup in pores)
